name: rdStartup
comment: RDroid library startup: stores the service table and builds the reciprocal/fixed-point tables Original name rdStartup (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): called from Main_Startup with hs on both sides, same body (stores rdroid_pHS, once flag bRDroidStartup)); was rdroid_Startup.

name: stdPlatform_Printf
comment: Platform service printf: formats into g_szDebugBuffer and OutputDebugString Original name stdPlatform_Printf (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the formatter all five grimdemo print callbacks call (formats into std_genBuffer)); was Svc_DebugPrintf.

name: grimlib_FindSystemFiles
comment: Original name grimlib_FindSystemFiles (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): same body (the result of sputLua_FindSystemFiles negated), called from Main_Startup); was Engine_RunSystemScript.

name: sputLua_FindSystemFiles
comment: lua_dofile('_system.lua') Original name sputLua_FindSystemFiles (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the only call of grimlib_FindSystemFiles, same body (lua_dofile of _system.lua)); was Lua_RunSystemScript.

name: grimlib_Open
comment: Original name grimlib_Open (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): called from Main_Startup, same body (once flag bSputmOpen, sputLua_Boot, grimlib_mode = 2, sputRender_Open, sputControl_Open)); was Engine_CallSystemFunction.

name: sputLua_Boot
comment: Calls the global Lua function named by the string at 0x004ec3c8 with (flag, str) Original name sputLua_Boot (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the boot-script call of grimlib_Open, same body (pushes the flag and string, calls the boot global)); was Lua_CallSystemFunction.

name: sputRender_Open
comment: Creates the hidden actor that carries the camera frame (g_hCameraActor) Original name sputRender_Open (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the render call of grimlib_Open, same body (allocates the camera actor gCamActorIndex, flag 1)); was Engine_CreateCameraActor.

name: sputControl_Open
comment: Original name sputControl_Open (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the control call of grimlib_Open, same body (stdControl_Open, then bControlOpen)); was Control_Capture.

name: stdControl_Open
comment: Original name stdControl_Open (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the only call of sputControl_Open (sets stdControl_bOpen and activates the controls)); was Input_Enable.

name: PolyglotInitialize
comment: Fills the 8-entry module interface {init, 0, shutdown=FUN_004c1e50, update, 0...} for the sound module Original name PolyglotInitialize (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the module-interface filler Main_Startup calls after stdStartup, same slots (itself, 0, startup, shutdown, 0...) and its pHS (the old name was wrong: it is the polyglot module)); was IMuseModule_Init.

name: polyglot_shutdown
comment: Module interface slot 3 of IMuseModule: frees g_pLanguageMalloc and the string table buffer. Original name polyglot_shutdown (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the shutdown slot PolyglotInitialize fills, same body (frees pLanguageMalloc and ppLanguageLine)); was IMuseModule_Stop.

name: PolyglotConfigure
comment: polyglot.c: loads the language table (text id -> translated string) Original name PolyglotConfigure (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the table load Main_Startup calls after PolyglotInitialize, same body (reads the .tab file through the polyglot pHS)); was Polyglot_LoadTable.

name: HostServicesInitialize
comment: Copies the 28-entry default service table (mostly stubs) from 0x004dd9a8 Original name HostServicesInitialize (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the first call of Main_Startup, same body (copies the default host-service table)); was Services_InitDefaults.

name: stdInitServices
comment: Original name stdInitServices (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the host-service set-up call of Main_Startup before stdStartup); was Services_InitPlatform.

name: stdStartup
comment: Stores the module service table in g_pServices and captures the FPU control words used for rounding modes Original name stdStartup (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): called from Main_Startup with hs before PolyglotInitialize, stores std_pHS then starts the platform layer); was Services_SetCurrent.
